desc:
Effective eBay order management gets open orders shipped, tracked and answered on time. Ecom Swift LLC works through your open orders, uploads tracking, buys labels in your account when you ask and sets up a handling routine for new sales.

## What is eBay order management?

eBay order management is everything that happens between a buyer paying and the parcel arriving: reading the order, packing, buying or printing a label, uploading tracking, replying to questions and dealing with changes such as combined shipping. It is routine work, but it has deadlines, and eBay measures how well you meet them.

Our service is a fixed sprint. We clear the current pile, build a routine for what comes next and leave you with a clear way to keep going. Day-to-day handling afterward is quoted separately.

## Why late tracking and slow replies cost sellers

Buyers on eBay expect to see tracking soon after they pay. An order with no tracking or a late scan invites messages, cancellations and complaints. Seller performance measures include handling time and late shipment, so repeated delays can lower your seller level and limit how your listings appear.

Slow replies add to the problem. A buyer who asks where an order is and hears nothing may open a case. A quick, polite message usually settles the matter before it becomes a formal dispute, which keeps your record clean.

## How a handling routine improves your results

A routine turns scattered effort into a repeatable system. When cut-off times, saved replies and a daily order check are written down, orders leave on schedule even in a busy week. Fewer late shipments and quicker answers support your seller level and make buyers more willing to leave positive feedback.

We do not control carriers, weather or buyer behavior, so parcels can still arrive late. What a good routine does is make sure the part within your control is always done on time and that problems are caught early.

## What good order handling includes

- A daily check of new orders, messages and orders about to go late.
- A clear cut-off time for same-day posting.
- Labels bought through your own eBay account, with the right service and weight.
- Tracking numbers uploaded so buyers see them in the order.
- Saved replies for the questions you get most often.
- A method for combined shipping and multi-item orders.
- A way to mark orders that need extra care, such as fragile items.
- Packing notes that reduce damage and returns.
- A hand-off guide that someone else could follow.

## What we do

We start with a review of your open orders and mark any that are at risk of going late. We upload tracking where you have shipped, and in higher packages we buy labels in your eBay account when you ask us to. We answer order questions in a calm, plain tone, and anything involving money or a refund waits for your decision.

Then we write your routine: cut-off times, a handling plan and the steps for each type of order. The Basic package covers a limited number of open orders and a written routine. The Standard package processes more orders, buys labels and answers messages. The Premium package adds saved reply templates, combined shipping steps and a guide for your own helper.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Upload tracking the same day you post.
- Reply to buyer questions within one working day.
- Photograph packed parcels of higher value before they leave.
- Keep handling times in your listings honest.
- Tell us in advance when you will be away.

**Avoid:**
- Posting without tracking on eBay orders.
- Promising delivery dates that a carrier controls.
- Changing the address on an order without checking with the buyer.
- Letting order questions wait until the weekend.
- Splitting a multi-item order without telling the buyer.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller who has fallen behind and wants the backlog cleared. It suits a shop preparing for a busy season, and an owner who plans to hire a helper and needs a written process they can follow.

## What we need from you

Send the order list or let us view your open orders, tell us your cut-off times and carrier choices and share any packing rules. We never ask for your password. We work as a limited user in your eBay account, and you control what we are allowed to do.
